links.comparator_used: Baseline low-temperature (0.1) answers to all questions, with no reliability scoring
links.outcome: Diagnostic/VQA answer accuracy on retained questions after filtering by discrete semantic entropy
links.effect: DSE > 0.3 filter: GPT-4o accuracy 51.7% to 76.3% (334/706 retained); GPT-4.1 54.8% to 63.8% (499/706 retained); both p < 0.001
links.tradeoff: Many questions go unanswered (372/706 excluded for GPT-4o, 207/706 for GPT-4.1). Each question needs 15 sampled responses at temperature 1.0 plus bidirectional entailment clustering.
links.quote: After filtering out high-entropy questions (DSE > 0.3), accuracy on the remaining questions was 76.3% (retained questions: 334/706) for GPT-4o and 63.8% (retained questions: 499/706) for GPT-4.1 (both p < 0.001).

links.comparator_used: Baseline answers to all questions with no uncertainty cutoff (low-temperature output for every question)
links.outcome: Accuracy on answered questions after rejecting high-entropy (DSE > 0.6 or > 0.3) questions
links.effect: DSE > 0.3 cutoff: GPT-4o 51.7% to 76.3%; GPT-4.1 54.8% to 63.8%; gains seen across both datasets and largely significant after Bonferroni correction
links.tradeoff: Fewer questions answered (334/706 retained for GPT-4o, 499/706 for GPT-4.1). The abstract does not report any human review of the rejected questions.
links.quote: DSE filtering at a 0.3 threshold increased GPT-4o accuracy from 51.7% to 76.3% and GPT-4.1 from 54.8% to 63.8%, while answering fewer questions.
